text.headline: Timeline of Kuwait
text.text: Major events in the history of Kuwait.

events.headline: Earliest Settlements
events.text: Archaeological evidence suggests that Kuwait was inhabited as early as 3000 BC, with settlements engaged in trade and fishing.

events.headline: Dilmun Civilization
events.text: Kuwait was part of the ancient Dilmun civilization, which was a major trading hub between Mesopotamia and the Indus Valley.

events.headline: Islamic Influence
events.text: With the spread of Islam in the 7th century, Kuwait became an important area for trade and culture in the Arabian Peninsula.

events.headline: Foundation of Kuwait City
events.text: The Al-Sabah family settled in Kuwait, establishing the city as a significant trading port in the Persian Gulf.

events.headline: Al-Sabah Dynasty Established
events.text: The Al-Sabah family was officially recognized as the ruling family of Kuwait, marking the beginning of its modern political structure.

events.headline: British Protectorate
events.text: Kuwait signed a treaty with Britain, becoming a protectorate in response to threats from the Ottoman Empire.

events.headline: Oil Discovery
events.text: Oil was discovered in Kuwait, leading to significant economic growth and transformation of the country.

events.headline: First Oil Exports
events.text: Kuwait began exporting oil, which became the backbone of its economy and led to rapid modernization.

events.headline: Independence from Britain
events.text: Kuwait gained full independence from British control on June 19, 1961, marking a new era in its history.

events.headline: First National Assembly
events.text: Kuwait held its first parliamentary elections, establishing a constitutional monarchy and a democratic framework.

events.headline: Nationalization of Oil Industry
events.text: Kuwait nationalized its oil industry, taking control of its oil resources and increasing revenue for development.

events.headline: Invasion by Iraq
events.text: Iraq invaded Kuwait, leading to the Gulf War and significant international military intervention.

events.headline: Liberation of Kuwait
events.text: Kuwait was liberated from Iraqi occupation after a coalition of forces led by the United States conducted Operation Desert Storm.

events.headline: Return to Democracy
events.text: Kuwait restored its parliament and democratic processes after the Gulf War, reaffirming its commitment to constitutional governance.

events.headline: Women Granted Voting Rights
events.text: Kuwait granted women the right to vote and run for office, marking a significant step towards gender equality in the region.

events.headline: Arab Spring Protests
events.text: Kuwait experienced a series of protests inspired by the Arab Spring, demanding political reforms and greater freedoms.

events.headline: Economic Challenges
events.text: Kuwait faced economic challenges due to falling oil prices, prompting discussions on economic diversification and reform.

events.headline: COVID-19 Pandemic
events.text: Kuwait implemented strict measures to combat the COVID-19 pandemic, impacting its economy and public health.

events.headline: Vaccination Rollout
events.text: Kuwait began its vaccination campaign against COVID-19, aiming to immunize its population and return to normalcy.

events.headline: Continued Economic Diversification
events.text: Kuwait continues to pursue economic diversification strategies to reduce its reliance on oil revenues and enhance sustainable development.
